description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. GIS-Mo road segments carry average-daily-traffic volume/year, truck/bus counts and future AADT/growth fields. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including AssetID, StateLRS, BMP, EMP, ADTSource, ADTVolume. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. The metadata does not establish observation years or estimation methods for every row; forecast fields must be separated from observed counts. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
